chunks.text:
[Turnaround]
{a short turnaround that leads smoothly straight back into the main theme, same tempo and key}
positive_styles: bright staccato pulse-wave lead that springs up on the downbeat and skips back down
fast flickering broken-triad arpeggio shimmering above like a kite tail
driving synth bass walking in steady eighths
brisk kick and snare with ticking hi-hat sixteenths
white-noise wind gust swells that rise and cut every four bars
high-altitude cliff-town overworld theme, wind and kites at sunset
seamless transition back to the theme
